title: Windows Support I
subject: Windows Fundamentals
description: 8 gamified support tickets focused on Windows installation, disk storage, local accounts, and file sharing. Use the 4-step workflow to document your findings and actions. Answers are not provided.

tickets.title: User cannot copy a large file to a USB drive
tickets.summary: A user reports 'Not enough space' when copying a single large file to a USB drive that appears to have free space.

env.Impact: User cannot transfer a required file

workflow.triage: Capture symptoms and scope. What is the exact error? What is the file size? What does Windows show as free space?
workflow.diagnosis: State your most likely root cause and the evidence you will use to confirm it.
workflow.fix: Document the GUI steps you will take to resolve it (and what you will verify after).
workflow.changeNote: Write a change record: what changed, why, impact, and validation.

validations: Verify the solution matches user constraints (data retention, tool limitations)

tickets.title: Windows Setup does not allow selecting the target disk
tickets.summary: During Windows installation, the target disk is missing or cannot be selected for installation.

workflow.triage: Capture exactly what the installer shows. Is the disk missing, offline, or blocked by a message?
workflow.diagnosis: State your likely root cause and the evidence you will use to confirm it (BIOS/UEFI checks, disk state, etc.).
workflow.fix: Document the GUI actions you will take to make the disk installable, keeping safety and approvals in mind.
workflow.changeNote: Write a change record: what changed, why, impact, and validation.

tickets.title: New disk attached but not visible in File Explorer
tickets.summary: A user can see a new disk in Disk Management but cannot use it in File Explorer.

env.Impact: Cannot store files on the new disk

workflow.triage: Capture the disk status shown in Disk Management.
workflow.diagnosis: State what is preventing the disk from being usable and what evidence confirms it.
workflow.fix: Document the GUI steps required to make the disk usable in File Explorer.
workflow.changeNote: Write a change record: what changed, why, impact, and validation.

tickets.title: A disk volume shows Offline and a drive is missing
tickets.summary: A volume that existed previously is now missing in File Explorer; Disk Management shows it as Offline.

workflow.triage: Confirm the type of disk and any recent changes (updates, power, docking, cable, enclosure).
workflow.diagnosis: State your likely cause and the evidence you will use to confirm it.
workflow.fix: Document the GUI steps to restore access safely (no destructive actions without explicit approval).
workflow.changeNote: Write a change record: what changed, why, impact, and validation.

validations: No new disk errors after fix

tickets.title: New user can sign in but cannot complete an approved install
tickets.summary: A user account was created, but the user cannot complete an approved installation that requires elevation.

workflow.triage: Capture the exact prompt/error and what action triggers it.
workflow.diagnosis: Determine why this behavior is occurring and what evidence confirms it (user group membership, elevation requirements).
workflow.fix: Document the least-privilege GUI path to complete the install (policy-compliant approach).
workflow.changeNote: Write a change record: what changed, why, impact, and validation.

validations: User can complete approved install via correct method

tickets.title: User can see a share but gets Access Denied opening files
tickets.summary: A user can browse to a shared folder but receives Access Denied when opening a file.

workflow.triage: Confirm whether the issue affects one user or many and what actions fail (browse, open, create, modify).
workflow.diagnosis: State your likely cause and what evidence you will use to confirm it (share perms, NTFS perms, effective access).
workflow.fix: Document the GUI steps to correct permissions with least privilege.
workflow.changeNote: Write a change record: what changed, why, impact, and validation.

tickets.title: Technician must prepare a disk using DiskPart (recovery console)
tickets.summary: You are in a recovery/setup command prompt and need to prepare a disk before installation or use.

workflow.triage: Identify the correct disk safely (avoid destructive actions on the wrong disk).
workflow.diagnosis: State what disk state prevents progress and what output would confirm it.
workflow.fix: Document the commands you would run (non-destructive first), and note when explicit approval is required for destructive actions.
workflow.changeNote: Write a change record: what changed, why, impact, and validation.

validations: Setup can proceed / volume mounts correctly

tickets.title: Bootable USB preparation requested for Windows installation
tickets.summary: A user needs a bootable USB prepared correctly for Windows installation.

env.Impact: Cannot install Windows without boot media

workflow.triage: Confirm target device boot mode expectations (UEFI vs legacy) and what media/tools are available.
workflow.diagnosis: State likely causes of a USB failing to boot in this environment and what checks confirm them.
workflow.fix: Document the steps to create bootable media (GUI approach and an optional CLI approach).
workflow.changeNote: Write a change record: what changed, why, impact, and validation.
